$comment: Typecheck-only, for `test/*.test.ts`. NOT used to build the package.
`node --test` strips types rather than checking them, so without this pass
the suite would be checked by nothing while still reporting green. Same
hole `interop` documents next door, and the same fix.
Needs `dist/` to exist: the tests import `../dist/index.js`, because dist
is what ships. `npm run typecheck` builds first.
